navalRules._doc: How much of each domain fights in each theatre. land = inland battles, coastal = raids/sieges on a port settlement, sea = fights on water. escortShare = part of the war-galley squadron strength added to every fight your own ships take on at sea.

kingdomNavy._doc: Royal fleets of the AI kingdoms (src/world/kingdomNavy.js). A realm keeps perPort strength per port settlement (+capitalPort if its capital is a port), x the best traitMultiplier, and never more than treasury / reservePerStrength. It builds buildRate of the gap a day at buildCost gold per point and pays upkeep gold per point a day. In a war fleets meet (battle.chance a day); a fleet with blockade.superiority over the enemy's blockades its ports: income falls by incomeLoss x the realm's port share, the attacker storms its ports with +siegeBonus, and its port markets pay marketSell / charge marketBuy, or close when the blockader is tightRatio times stronger. Hostile fleets intercept the player's ships within intercept.radius of their ports. liegeService: galleys a sworn player lends the liege's fleet in war.

sieges._doc: Sieges as operations (src/systems/sieges.js). Investing a settlement starts a siege; each day the defenders eat their stores, lose morale and may fall sick, while the camp forages and eats from the packs, may fall sick and desert. Stances: blockade (tighten the cordon), works (build an engine), sap (dig a mine under the walls). Storm, negotiate terms, fight a relief host or lift the siege.

ram.name: Battering ram
ram.effect: Breaks the gate: the defence is 15% weaker when you storm.

tower.name: Siege tower
tower.effect: Carries men over the walls: walls count half when you storm.

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.effect: Batters the walls every day (-6 integrity a day).
